title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer /referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo. Must-haves 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end) Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.Js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data Plusses Experience with C++ development Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes Day-to-Day You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

title: Analista De Testes Sênior
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that. --- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations. --- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence. --- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet. --- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company. --- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream. --- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a "stable" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you. --- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.**- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us. --- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply. --- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage."** Be specific. We want the actual story.

description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that. --- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations. --- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence. --- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet. --- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company. --- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream. --- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a "stable" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you. --- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.**- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us. --- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply. --- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage."** Be specific. We want the actual story.

title: Account Manager
description: Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. title: Investment Banking Intern
description: Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship. We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets. Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region. What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling Sourcing & Due Diligence Industry and Company Research And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals. Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing. This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals. Who We're Looking For: This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment. How to Apply: Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase. This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Product Mananger Sênior - Digital Acquisition (Nike Brasil)
description: Senior Product Manager – Digital Acquisition (Nike Brasil | Grupo SBF) Seu Desafio Não buscamos um\ "piloto de backlog\" ,mas umPM com olhar empreendedor e profundidade no negócio. Você será o responsável por liderar a estratégia de Digital Acquisition do site e app da Nike no Brasil, legal, né? Sua missão é clara: atrair novos usuários, dominar a busca orgânica e transformar a experiência de descoberta de produtos em uma máquina de crescimento sustentável. Aqui, Produto = Negócio. Você terá autonomia para executar o que acredita, desde que suas convicções sejam embasadas por dados, pensamento crítico e uma visão profunda do mercado de varejo. O que você vai fazer Atrair pessoas e torná-las usuárias recorrentes através de: Domínio de SEO & Discovery: Liderar SEO técnico (indexabilidade, performance, arquitetura de URLs) e evoluir a encontrabilidade (Busca, Filtros, Grids e Menus). Playbook de Growth: Priorizar iniciativas de alto impacto como\ "Avise-me\", Web/App Pushes eGrowth Loops. Influência e Educação: Atuar como um agente que eleva a maturidade digital da organização, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções tecnológicas escaláveis. O Perfil que buscamos 1. Visão de Negócio & Estratégia: Você mergulha no segmento, entende de marketing, economia e negociação. Consegue encontrar brechas no mercado e transformá-las em vantagem competitiva. 2. Capacidade Analítica\ "Data-Informed\": Saber dizer\ "não\" é sua maior ferramentade priorização. Você usa dados (quant e quali) para convencer, inferir o tamanho de oportunidades e validar hipóteses. 3. Execução e Senso de Urgência: O varejo não espera. Precisamos de maestria na execução, foco e dedicação. Aqui, trabalhamos com velocidade, inteligência e sem acomodação. 4. Mentalidade AI Native: Você utiliza IA como ferramenta fundamental no dia a dia — seja para acelerar análises, escrever queries no BigQuery ou estruturar narrativas. 5. Articulação Cross-functional: Constrói relacionamentos sólidos com Engenharia, Design e Mídia, movimentando pessoas em prol de uma visão comum. Requisitos Sólida experiência como PM Sênior, preferencialmente em Growth ou Aquisição Digital. Conhecimento técnico e estratégico em SEO, navegação e experiência de busca. Familiaridade com o stack de dados: GA4, Search Console e SQL (BigQuery). Habilidade de validação ágil: Saber gerar valor desde o\ "dia zero\", validando ideiasde forma rápida (muitas vezes sem código). KPIs: O que define o seu sucesso? Receita incremental atribuída à aquisição. Qualidade de visualização de Grid e PDP. Volume e conversão de sessões orgânicas. Retenção de tráfego (Return Visitors). Por que essa vaga? Se você tem senso de ownership, não se contenta com o básico e quer liderar o digital da maior marca esportiva do mundo dentro de um ambiente de varejo competitivo e dinâmico, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Desenvolvedor Rpa Uipath
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation. Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath. title: Marketing Coordinator
description: Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level? At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video. We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment. Your Goals Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences). Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels. Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages). Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts. Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners. Qualifications 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count). Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot). Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities. Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills. Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment. Benefits Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team. Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded. Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video. Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path. 100% Remote position working with a global team. Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit. About Us Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
